# sofascore_scraper.store.SliceInfo
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/events.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SliceInfo:
    ref: Ref
    key: str
    sub: str
    state: str
    has_payload: bool
    fetched_at: Optional[datetime]
    checked_at: Optional[datetime]
    empty_count: int
    unverified_empty_count: int
    error: Optional[SliceError]
    stored_bytes: Optional[int]
    raw_bytes: Optional[int]
    history_count: int
    meta: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    def settled_empty(self, threshold: int = DEFAULT_EMPTY_THRESHOLD) -> bool
